title: An integrated approach for automatic safety inspection in construction: Domain knowledge with multimodal large language model
task: 多模态施工安全检查与风险推理
inputData: 施工现场图像 + 文本查询 + 安全法规、指南和手册构成的领域知识库
contribution: 提出由领域微调多模态模型、施工安全知识库和多步推理引擎组成的自动安全检查框架，将LoRA视觉指令微调与语义分块、稀疏/稠密混合检索结合，在真实地铁施工场景中完成知识增强的安全风险识别与解释。
abstract: The study combines a fine-tuned multimodal large model, a domain safety knowledge base, and a multi-step reasoning engine for construction safety inspection. Visual instruction tuning adapts the multimodal model to construction scenes, while retrieved regulations and guidance ground decomposed reasoning tasks before a final safety assessment is synthesized. The framework is validated with real-world data from Wuhan metro construction sites.
methodology: The framework has three components: a multimodal model, a domain knowledge base, and a reasoning engine. Construction-site image–text instruction data are used for PEFT with LoRA; 2,357 image-text pairs (90% of the dataset) are used for fine-tuning the 13B model on two NVIDIA A6000 GPUs. Safety regulations and authoritative handbooks are semantically chunked and embedded with BGE. At inference, hybrid retrieval combines BM25 lexical matching with dense-vector cosine similarity. The reasoning engine performs visual perception, task breakdown, knowledge retrieval/synthesis and final-output generation under a prompt library.
results: The detailed evaluation reports task-breakdown relevancy of 0.98 and completeness of 0.78. Final-task reasoning achieves faithfulness of 0.95 and a without-hallucination score of 0.98, while referenced hazard-identification correctness is 0.57. The method was validated with real on-site data from Wuhan metro construction projects, demonstrating moderate hazard-identification performance but strong contextual relevance and final reasoning faithfulness.
taskEn: Multimodal construction safety inspection and risk reasoning
inputDataEn: Construction-site images, text queries, and a domain knowledge base of safety regulations, guidelines, and handbooks
operationEvidence: The runtime retrieves safety evidence through hybrid sparse/dense search, analyzes images and decomposed safety sub-tasks, and generates an evaluated final safety assessment/recommendation grounded in retrieved knowledge.
